fix.fix_summary: FR13_CONV_COMMITTED_PATH (default ON, revertible via =0). Read-first finding: the per-node tree-conv write-back already stores each node's bank row as the last width-1 taps of (prior ++ that node's root-path tokens) — path-correct per node; the spine-valid-only assumption lives in the CONSUMER: the legacy prior read gathers spec_state_indices[:, accepted_len-1] AFTER launch_tree_state_linear_remap has permuted the conv bank in place, so its correctness for BRANCH winners depends entirely on the in-place linear remap executing exactly. Fix: new graph-safe helper gather_committed_path_conv_prior() (src/lumo_flywheel_serving/fr10_gdn_tree_kernel.py, tensor-ops only, no host sync) gathers the accepted path's LEAF NODE column (accepted_paths[b, len-1], node-indexed pre-remap layout; len==0 -> node 0) and snapshots it BEFORE the remap mutates the bank — by write-back construction this IS the committed token path's window (root..accepted leaf; the next event's node-0 row is the bonus, whose 3-token prior window = exactly those taps). Wired into the conv_replacement patch string ahead of the remap launch (fail-loud inside the existing FR10_ALLOW_LINEAR_FALLBACK-gated try); the read site prefers the committed snapshot, with the legacy post-remap linear read byte-intact behind FR13_CONV_COMMITTED_PATH=0; the remap itself (ssm+conv) and the legacy ssm publish/remap/h0 handoff (m1 seam 2, replay-route territory) are untouched. Capture truthfulness: prior_read_mode now reports committed_path_node/compact_head/native_tail_pre_remap and read_cols holds NODE columns under the flag. Semantics-preserving license proven: the accepted leaf's node id always exceeds every remap destination column (path[k]>=k+1), so its row is never a remap destination — spine winners are byte-identical to legacy (tested), branch winners equal legacy only under an exact remap (tested + documented, so any live legacy-vs-committed divergence localizes the remap/aliasing machinery). Launcher forwards the flag (default 1); FR13_FLAGS.md documents it. Activates on next vLLM relaunch through the launcher (container re-patch).
